body.statement: If \(d_n\) is a fixed integer sequence with \(d_n\ge3\), then \(r(n,d_n)=\Theta(n^{-1})\), so Theorem 1 reduces to the ordinary parametric MSE order. If \(G\) has girth at least five, then \(B_2(G)=A_G^2+A_G-(d_n-1)I_n\); hence \(\|A_GP_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}=O(\sqrt{d_n})\) implies \(\|B_2(G)P_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}=O(d_n)\), a strict special case of the open Boolean operator target.
body.justification: These reductions prevent the proposed frontier from contradicting the no-growth parametric benchmark and isolate Boolean collisions as the only new graph-spectral issue.
body.gap: BauerschmidtEtAl2020EdgeRigidity and Sarid2023SpectralGap supply adjacency spectral control, but not the Boolean collision identity outside the high-girth special case.
body.consumer: The fixed degree-four design motivated by ShiEtAl2020FreedomChoice recovers order-\(n^{-1}\) MSE and order-\(n^{-1/2}\) confidence radius.
